title: Josh Payne was a builder. How did he become a billionaire in two years?
summary: Josh Payne, known as 'Payno', transitioned from a coal miner to a crane rigger on construction sites, and later became a bitcoin miner in his spare time. He founded Nscale, a start-up in AI that raised $2 billion and is pivotal to the UK's AI ambitions, with notable figures joining its board. Despite his success, Payne's personal history and business operations remain somewhat enigmatic.
sentiment_reason: The article presents a mix of neutral and negative sentiment due to the mention of Payne's mysterious background and the controversial nature of his employment history, but it is primarily negative because of the lack of transparency and the controversies surrounding his past.
